reviews.findings_json: ["Trusted-internal bypass is forgeable: `evaluateInboundAuthenticityGate` accepts `trusted_provenance` directly from its caller, and the exported `buildTrustedInternalProvenance(event_type)` creates a valid bypass object from arbitrary input. An untrusted caller can therefore construct `buildTrustedInternalProvenance('internal.tick')` and materialize state without connector authentication, violating the requirement that trusted-internal classification come only from trusted infrastructure provenance."]

["Trusted-internal provenance is forgeable: evaluateInboundAuthenticityGate accepts a plain caller-supplied trusted_provenance object, and classifyTrustedInternalProvenance only checks matching string fields. An untrusted caller can pass {classification:\"TRUSTED_INTERNAL\",source:\"agencyos.trusted-runtime\",event_type:\"internal.tick\"} (or call the exported builder) and bypass authenticity, allowing materialization. The provenance must be produced/enforced by a non-forgeable trusted infrastructure boundary, capability, or equivalent mechanism."]

["Trusted-internal provenance is forgeable by callers: buildTrustedInternalProvenance() is exported and returns an ordinary object, while evaluateInboundAuthenticityGate/processInboundEvent accept any caller-supplied trusted_provenance object and classify it solely by matching public string fields. An untrusted caller can therefore construct buildTrustedInternalProvenance('internal.tick') and bypass external authenticity, violating the locked requirement that trusted-internal classification come only from positive infrastructure provenance."]
